title: Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction
official: Randomized Study Evaluating the Value of a Pre-habilitation Stay and Digital Follow-up, Compared With Standard Management, in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction
summary: This study evaluates the effectiveness of a pre-habilitation stay via digital monitoring on patients' short-term post-operative anxiety, compared with conventional management.

interventions.name: Reconstructive surgery of the anterior cruciate ligament

sponsor: GCS Ramsay Santé pour l'Enseignement et la Recherche
